description: Their birthday, read from memory, on a casual morning message: with the calendar's note it marks the day warmly in a few words and answers them, without saying it remembered or looked it up (R19). Run with the note: +note=PATH@tail, PATH holding notes/occasion-theirs rendered with their birthday.

script.clock: Right now it is Friday 4 December 2026, 09:40.

checks.criterion: The companion has a private note that today is the user's birthday. The user just said good morning. The reply PASSES if it greets them and wishes them a happy birthday warmly, in a few words, the way a friend would. It FAILS if it never mentions the birthday, says or implies it remembered, looked up, noted or kept track of the date, turns into a speech of several sentences about the birthday, or assumes plans, a party or family.
